arguments.sql:
WITH ranked_transactions AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        d.A2 AS district_name,
        a.account_id,
        t.balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY a.account_id
            ORDER BY t.date DESC, t.trans_id DESC
        ) AS transaction_rank
    FROM main.account AS a
    JOIN main.district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    LEFT JOIN main.trans AS t
        ON t.account_id = a.account_id
       AND t.date < '1997-01-01'
    WHERE a.date >= '1996-01-01'
      AND a.date < '1997-01-01'
      AND d.A3 = (SELECT A3 FROM main.district WHERE A2 = 'Litomerice')
),
account_balances AS (
    SELECT district_id, district_name, account_id, balance
    FROM ranked_transactions
    WHERE transaction_rank = 1
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) AS distinct_accounts,
       COUNT(balance) AS balances, SUM(typeof(balance) = 'integer') AS integer_balances,
       MIN(balance) AS minimum_balance, MAX(balance) AS maximum_balance
FROM account_balances

decimal_bounds AS (
  SELECT group_id, scaled_value,
    COUNT(scaled_value) OVER g AS n,
    SUM(CASE WHEN scaled_value IS NOT NULL AND typeof(scaled_value) <> 'integer' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER g AS invalid_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN typeof(scaled_value) = 'integer' AND scaled_value NOT BETWEEN -90071992547409 AND 90071992547409 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER g AS oversized_count,
    TOTAL(CASE WHEN typeof(scaled_value) = 'integer' AND scaled_value BETWEEN -90071992547409 AND 90071992547409 THEN ABS(scaled_value) ELSE 0 END) OVER g AS abs_total
  FROM decimal_input
  WINDOW g AS (PARTITION BY group_id)
), decimal_totals AS (
  SELECT group_id, n, invalid_count,
    CASE WHEN invalid_count > 0 THEN 'invalid_input'
      WHEN n = 0 THEN 'empty'
      WHEN oversized_count > 0 OR abs_total > 90071992547409
        OR n > 9007199254740991 THEN 'overflow'
      ELSE 'ok' END AS status,
    SUM(CASE WHEN invalid_count = 0 AND oversized_count = 0
      AND abs_total <= 90071992547409 AND n <= 9007199254740991
      THEN scaled_value END) AS scaled_sum
  FROM decimal_bounds
  GROUP BY group_id
), decimal_fraction AS (
  SELECT group_id, n, invalid_count, status,
    scaled_sum * 100 AS numerator, n * 1 AS denominator
  FROM decimal_totals
), decimal_rounded AS (
  SELECT group_id, n, invalid_count, status,
    CASE WHEN status = 'ok' THEN numerator / denominator
      + CASE WHEN ABS(numerator % denominator) >= (denominator + 1) / 2
        THEN CASE WHEN numerator < 0 THEN -1 ELSE 1 END ELSE 0 END END AS rounded_units
  FROM decimal_fraction
), decimal_result AS (
  SELECT *, rounded_units * 1.0 / 100 AS rounded_value
  FROM decimal_rounded
)
